program_policy_authority: authenticated official Bugcrowd engagement brief; exclusions override wildcards

recheck_requirements: Read current authenticated Bugcrowd brief and changelog
Verify all target redirects and third party ownership
Do not enable live requests until all authorization gates explicitly pass

hard_exclusions: Any unlisted/ambiguous host, third-party service, redirect, CNAME or content delivery origin without explicit approval
Any real customer/merchant data or funds
Credential stuffing, unauthorized account access, social engineering, DDoS, rate-limit exhaustion
All automation/scripts against Rapyd support forms
Bulk discovery, intrusive scanning, purchasing, transfers, refunds and payouts on production
Private repos, internal networks, employee endpoints, physical targets

severity.rule: Use Bugcrowd VRT and observed impact; do not assign priority to an unverified hypothesis. P3 must show a real security boundary, not cosmetic or best-practice gaps.

lane_map.A: Web build, frontend trust, deployment and exposed configuration only on in-scope web assets (not arbitrary GitHub repositories)
lane_map.B: Authentication, authorization, merchant and tenant isolation, sessions, signature design
lane_map.C: Input-to-server trust boundary, parser and backend safety via local mocks, fixtures and authorized minimal tests
lane_map.D: Checkout, hosted verification, cross-origin redirects, browser/session boundaries
lane_map.E: Webhook, idempotency, event-ordering and financial state invariants via owned fixtures; no real-money or third-party transactions

evidence_gates.G0: Confirmed current official scope+program testing authorization+actual attacker/owned test persona
evidence_gates.G1: A concrete reachable Rapyd security boundary, exact affected asset and pinned version/timestamp
evidence_gates.G2: Controlled bounded positive reproduction and negative control; distinguish mock from actual target
evidence_gates.G3: Independent security consequence/invariant, realistic impact, counterexample and no harm
evidence_gates.G4: Defensible VRT priority, known issue/duplicate review, clean-room reproducibility, sanitized private report

reporting.destination: Bugcrowd Rapyd engagement (manual researcher review/submission only)

note: This is a planning snapshot; not an authorization token, not an attestation the live brief was read, and not permission for unattended active live probing.
